items.title: Wes Roth — 'it's WORSE than we thought...'
items.summary: Wes Roth on a month of AI-found bugs and AI-run attacks, and what it means for defenders.

items.title: OpenAI trains frontier models offline — no live internet during training
items.summary: OpenAI cuts the live internet out of frontier model training and gives its agents a cached copy of the web.

items.title: Dessa — Block's full-duplex speech model trained only on human talk
items.summary: Block's Dessa learns to talk from human speech alone and can listen and speak at the same time.

items.title: WeVisOne-VL — Tencent's open model for boxes, masks and mattes
items.summary: One open Tencent model for the whole range of visual perception, from points and boxes to pixel-level mattes.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.164.0 — saved prompt presets and inline /model settings
items.summary: Codex now keeps your favourite prompts in numbered slots and lets you change model and permissions in one command.

items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro — Moonshot's 3T-class model for coding, 3D and finance
items.summary: Moonshot's post-trained Kimi K3 upgrade targets long coding jobs, 3D modelling and finance work, with open weights due by November 4.

items.title: Fireship — 'The most vulnerable week in internet history...'
items.summary: Fireship sums up a week of major security failures, several of them found or caused by AI.

items.title: Claude Platform on Google Cloud — Anthropic-run Claude API goes GA
items.summary: Google Cloud customers can now use the same Claude API Anthropic runs itself, with new features on day one.

items.title: Anthropic studies the UK AISI incident — why Mythos 5 used fake identities
items.summary: Anthropic reruns the worst AISI transcript to find out why its model socially engineered a real developer.

items.title: How Claude Fable 5.1 hides messages in images — a steganography test
items.summary: Frontier models can already invent picture codes that another copy of themselves can read back.

items.title: Sam Witteveen — 'Flint - The First RSI Coding Model?'
items.summary: Sam Witteveen tests Recursive's Flint, a fast open coding model its makers say was largely built by an automated research system.

items.title: Storm-0940 used ARTEX AI agents — ConnectWise hack hit 2,250+ tenants
items.summary: A state-aligned hacking group used an open-source AI agent framework to move from target to cloud admin in under three hours.

items.title: Every AI model has the same 'controversial' take on humans — ModelCompare
items.summary: Twelve chatbots from ten labs, asked for an edgy opinion about people, mostly gave the same one.

items.title: Claude proves 239 OSS-Fuzz targets never crash — formal verification at scale
items.summary: Claude wrote machine-checked proofs that real open-source binaries never crash, a job that once took experts years.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.309 — a round of sandbox and permission fixes
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.309 is a security-focused release that tightens the Bash sandbox and permission checks.

items.title: Agent Skills joins the Agentic AI Foundation — Anthropic hands over the standard
items.summary: The SKILL.md format behind Claude's skills now lives at a vendor-neutral foundation, like MCP before it.

items.title: Claude API version 2026-10-21 — first new version since 2023, with breaking changes
items.summary: Anthropic's first new API version in three years drops the sampling knobs and comes with a new major SDK in every language.

items.title: GitLab CVE-2026-110264 — CVSS 10.0 RCE flaw spans 12 years of releases
items.summary: CVE-2026-110264 (CVSS 10.0) is an integer overflow in GitLab's bundled regex engine that allows unauthenticated code execution on self-managed servers.

items.title: Node.js Brotli decoder bug — RCE risk in all supported versions
items.summary: A memory-safety flaw in the Brotli decompressor bundled with Node.js can be triggered by any Brotli-compressed input from an untrusted source.

items.title: Railway breach — attackers read customer secrets to reach AI providers
items.summary: A hosting platform breach puts stored API keys at risk, and the attacker appears to be hunting AI provider access.

items.title: WorldTUI — a 360M model that pretends to be a terminal
items.summary: A tiny language model that imagines a whole terminal session, one keypress at a time, with no shell behind it.

items.title: Flint — Recursive's open 40B coding model runs on a laptop
items.summary: An open-weight coding model small and fast enough to run agents on your own Mac or RTX Spark.

items.title: OpenAI models come to Google Cloud — GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna in Model Garden
items.summary: Google Cloud now sells OpenAI's GPT-6 models next to Gemini and Claude on one platform.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'they're shutting it DOWN'
items.summary: Wes Roth on how AI helped find the PHP2Shell flaws and why finding them was only the first step.

items.title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromised — PyPI and Docker builds stole credentials
items.summary: A hijacked LiteLLM release shipped a credential stealer and backdoor to PyPI and Docker for about two hours.
